name: Impeccable
author: paulbakaus
description: Detect UI anti-patterns and design quality issues. Scans HTML, CSS, JSX, TSX, Vue, and Svelte files for 44 deterministic rules including AI-generated UI tells, accessibility violations, and general design quality problems. Catches: side-tab accent borders, gradient text on headings, purple/violet gradients, cyan-on-dark palettes, monotonous spacing, nested cards, bounce easing, etc.

view.label: Impeccable
view.description: UI anti-pattern detector. Run scans from here.

scope.description: Directory to scan. Defaults to src/.

external.description: Impeccable is a published npm skill. This mod records scan results in the project's Obsidian vault under `.obsidian/impeccable/`.
